rule_exclusions.reason: 本次主视觉要求干净平面大色块和精确字形，纸粒条件停用。

text.zh: 表现阅读活动的主标题与抽象纸页轮廓组成的海报。
text.en: Create a reading-event poster featuring the main title and abstract page silhouettes.

text.zh: 日期紧随主标题置于下方并降低字号，保持从上到下的阅读顺序。
text.en: Set the date immediately below the main title at a smaller size, preserving a top-to-bottom reading order.

text.zh: 用展墙般的平面大冷色块建立安静环境。
text.en: Establish a quiet setting with broad cool color masses like a flat exhibition wall.

text.zh: 画面使用干净的平面色块，优先保证字形边缘清楚。
text.en: Use clean flat color areas and prioritize crisp glyph edges.

text.zh: 广阔的低饱和冷灰蓝展墙构成海报基底，少量琥珀暖色只用于标题和近旁的一小处投光。
text.en: Use a broad, low-saturation cool blue-gray exhibition wall as the poster base; restrict the small amber accent to the title and a small nearby light patch.

text.zh: 主标题字面边缘清楚连续，纸页和展墙的轮廓较弱并断续融入相邻色面。
text.en: Keep the title glyph edges clear and continuous; weaken and break the page and wall contours into the neighboring masses.

text.zh: 细节与图文对比集中于标题区，外围保留疏略纸页面形和大面积低密度色块。
text.en: Concentrate detail and text contrast in the title area; retain sparse page silhouettes and broad, low-density masses around it.

text.zh: 由暗色纸页面形引导视线读到主标题，让唯一暖点、清晰边缘和主要细节在文字区域会合。
text.en: Guide the eye from the dark page silhouettes to the main title, where the only warm accent, clearest edges, and primary detail converge.
